canonical_project: DigiCo SYD1 (400 Harris Street, Ultimo - ex-Global Switch Sydney)
notes: 400 Harris Street, Ultimo (City of Sydney LGA): former Global Switch Sydney flagship (26MW colo), acquired by HMC Capital for ~$1.94bn (Oct 2024) and rebranded DigiCo SYD1; Ultimo expansion reportedly adding ~60MW (Wilson AM quoting DigiCo CEO). capacity_mw = current operational 26MW.
